services.name: Business Intelligence & Data Analytics
services.description: Turn scattered business data into clear dashboards and decisions.
services.audience: Businesses that have data spread across sheets and systems but no clear view of performance.
deliverables: Interactive dashboard (Power BI, Excel or another suitable tool)
Identification of trends, unusual movements and performance gaps
Dashboard user guide and handover session

services.name: HR Consulting & People Analytics
services.description: Understand your workforce and build smoother HR processes.
services.audience: Growing teams facing hiring, onboarding or employee retention challenges.
deliverables: Mapping of recruitment, onboarding or employee administration workflows
Cleaning and structuring of an agreed employee dataset

services.name: Financial Planning & Forecasting
services.description: See where your business stands financially and where it’s heading.
services.audience: Founders and managers who need clearer budgets, forecasts and financial tracking.
deliverables: Review of available P&L statements, balance sheets and cash flow information
Revenue, expense and profitability trend analysis
Financial ratios and working capital indicators
Financial forecast based on agreed assumptions

services.name: Market & Competitor Intelligence
services.description: Know your market, your competitors and your next opportunity.
services.audience: Businesses planning growth, a new launch or a sharper position against competitors.
deliverables: Customer segment and value proposition assessment
Analysis of leads, conversion rate, cost per lead and customer acquisition cost (where data permits)
Marketing KPI reporting and campaign performance summary
Research report with findings, sources and recommendations

services.name: AI Transformation and Advisory
services.description: Plan AI adoption, equip your team and put responsible AI use into practice.
services.audience: Businesses exploring AI adoption, chatbots, employee training and AI governance.

faqs.question: How do you use AI in your work?
faqs.answer: AI helps us clean data, analyse it and research markets much faster. Every insight and recommendation is reviewed and shaped by our team before it reaches you.

faqs.question: Do you work with businesses outside India?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work with businesses in India and internationally.

faqs.question: How is pricing decided?
faqs.answer: Every business is different, so we prepare a quote based on the scope of your project. Email us with a few details and we’ll get back to you.

faqs.question: What do you need from us to get started?
faqs.answer: A short conversation about your goals and access to the relevant data or documents for the service you choose.

faqs.question: Which service is right for my business?
faqs.answer: If you’re not sure, email us and describe your challenge. We’ll suggest the package that fits best.
